evidence.title: 日下舊聞考 紫碧山房
evidence.excerpt_zh: 鴻慈永祜後垣西北為紫碧山房前宇為横雲堂山房東巖洞中為石帆室東南為豐樂軒北為霽華樓迤東為景暉樓横雲堂西池上為澄素樓西北為引溪亭（圎圓明園册）臣等謹按紫碧山房額有二其一恭懸正宇内一懸穿堂門檐與引溪亭額皆世宗御書紫碧山房正宇檐額曰樂在人和及横雲堂諸額皆皇上御書
evidence.summary: North-west beyond the rear wall of 鴻慈永祜: 紫碧山房 with 横雲堂, the cave room 石帆室, 豐樂軒, 霽華樓, 景暉樓, 澄素樓 on the pond and 引溪亭.

evidence.title: 澄素楼: 乾隆二十六年 poem of the Qianlong Emperor
evidence.date: 乾隆二十六年 (1761), date from the compilation
evidence.excerpt_zh: 层屋镜中央，石桥接径长。春秋风月趣，上下水天光。澄到尘无处，素先绘有常。不忘参理性，揽景定何妨。
evidence.summary: Poem of the Qianlong Emperor at 澄素楼, 1761, on the view. Year as given by the compilation.

evidence.title: 澄素楼
evidence.locator: v3 p.131, under 紫碧山房; source ref 17-177
evidence.excerpt_zh: 澄素固在溪，而楼适溪上。溪澄楼亦澄，曰二原一样。然人弗拾级，孰能知其状。得一则含三，天成坦荡荡。万理顺其然，夫岂劳施张。
evidence.summary: Poem 澄素楼 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1790, filed by the editors under 紫碧山房.

evidence.title: 澄素楼: 嘉庆二十二年 poem of the Jiaqing Emperor
evidence.date: 嘉庆二十二年 (1817), date from the compilation
evidence.excerpt_zh:
小楼石洞
右，凭槛望西山。村外排青嶂，峰头袅翠鬟。试耕园户队，习射羽林班。教养无非事，力勤警怠顽。（楼在御园西北隅，俯临稻畦，暇时来观稼穑，近于十九年命内务府添建营房，训练士卒，亦兵农不可偏废之意耳）
evidence.summary: Poem of the Jiaqing Emperor at 澄素楼, 1817. Year as given by the compilation.

evidence.title: 澄素楼: 嘉庆二十五年 poem of the Jiaqing Emperor
evidence.date: 嘉庆二十五年 (1820), date from the compilation
evidence.excerpt_zh: 拾级上层楼，春郊韶景悠。线青新柳曳，眉翠远山浮。小溆波初活，平畴麦始抽。阳和盎品物，仁政及时修。
evidence.summary: Poem of the Jiaqing Emperor at 澄素楼, 1820, on the harvest and the view. Year as given by the compilation.

evidence.title: 澄素楼作
evidence.locator: v3 p.122, under 紫碧山房; source ref 8-439
evidence.excerpt_zh: 层屋静中央，石桥接迳长。春秋风月趣，上下水天光。澄到尘无处，素先绘有常。不忘参理性，揽景定何妨。
evidence.summary: Poem 澄素楼作 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1761, filed by the editors under 紫碧山房.

evidence.title: 圆明园百景史事分景汇编: 澄素楼
evidence.locator: from p.197, under 紫碧山房
evidence.summary: A Jiaqing note of 1817 puts it in the north-west corner over the rice fields, with new barracks added near it in 1814. 澄素楼: 6 dated items, 1761-1820, of which 6 poems (Qianlong, Jiaqing); recurring themes: the view, the harvest. First dated 1761, last dated 1820.

evidence.title: 紫碧山房 2017, 新京报 via 中新网
evidence.summary: 紫碧山房 Zibi Shanfang, the highest point of the garden in the far north-west, yielded a service house, gate, the halls 紫碧山房, 含余清 and 澄素楼, a landing, stone bridge, walls, roads, channel and hill. Remains absent from the documents also appeared: an earlier wall footing with its apron, a retaining wall of the hill, a semicircular landing, a drain and a stone path.

searched: No picture of it found in the Forty Scenes album, its 1745 woodcuts, the Bertin gouaches and the 1887 lithograph; the 20 Xiyang Lou plates; ruin photographs on Commons, at Östasiatiska museet, the Slovene Ethnographic Museum, Historical Photographs of China, the Rijksmuseum, Wellcome and in NDL's albums of about 1900; today's photographs on Commons.
